# Finite acquired evidence for reusable operations

Private Astra P3, 23 October 2026. This extends `CORRELATION_CERTIFICATE.md`.
It preserves a conditional theorem and executable construction, including
its failed applicability cases and the equally informed retaining-program
tie. It does not establish a new architecture, a physical deployment, or a
general law of cumulative intelligence. Historical novelty and practical
advantage are UNKNOWN.

The governing Astra corpus revision remains
`0451552424b4679fa9a73faf5849ea5a4af21cf6`. N780 motivates distinguishing
acquisition within a promised class from recognition of that class. No N51
oracle or representation is used. Earlier circuit, network, finite-bit,
composition, repair, and retaining-comparison bundles are unchanged.

## 1. The operation and its external obstruction

The task is to predict the bounded endpoint correlation of a previously
unqueried, open-loop sequence of interventions on a partially observed
stochastic system. The learner need not identify the hidden state space.
It must acquire enough information to bound its own output error.

A concrete obstruction in stochastic residual DMD is that a single noisy
future gives a squared prediction error containing both a conditional-mean
residual and stochastic variance. Two independent futures from the same
initial state separate these quantities. See Colbrook, Li, Raut and Townsend,
*Beyond expectations: Residual Dynamic Mode Decomposition and Variance for
Stochastic Dynamical Systems*, arXiv:2308.10697v3, sections 3.2 and 4.2:
https://arxiv.org/html/2308.10697v3 .

The mechanism studied here acquires the needed bilinear residual information
through adjoint pulse sequences instead. This is a different access mechanism,
not an improvement over a baseline that is forbidden to use the same data.
It is useful only where the adjoint/preparation contract can be warranted
and its complete cost is acceptable. In a state-clonable simulator, the
batched-future alternative remains fully available.

# P3 finite acquired evidence for reusable operations — 24 October 2026

This selected update preserves a second P3 mechanism for acquiring task-sufficient information: stationary adjoint endpoint correlations yield a residual-corrected predictor for every finite open-loop intervention word, and the same retained operation composes into finite-schedule variance bounds. It complements the separate P3 coordinate-chart and acquired-action result in [the operations return](../2026-10-24-p3-acquired-operations-return/README.md); it does not replace it.

## Mechanism and requirements

The predictor uses a finite paid correlation table to construct an implicit feature Gram matrix and hidden-action residuals. Exact finite-bit inequalities bound pointwise prediction error for all finite words without identifying the hidden state count, full rank, or model completeness. The finite-schedule second moment of a run average is a nonnegative weighted sum of those correlations, so the same operation gives a variance interval for any stated finite open-loop schedule. An ordinary retaining weighted program implements the predictor exactly; the operation has no architecture advantage over a learner with the same observations and warrants.

The acquisition contract supplies a common stationary law, bounded nondisturbing readout, independent stationary starts or a controlled dependence analysis, and actual adjoint actions. Reversing a waveform is not itself an adjoint, and short observed correlations do not warrant stationary preparation. The theorem's requirements are not inferred from the acquired moments.

## Obtainable simulator route and fair comparisons

A restricted constructive route uses exact rational attractive finite-spin factors, monotone coupling from the past for independent stationary starts, and reverse-order complete heat-bath sweeps for actual adjoints. It charges local conditional-table preparation, random-map generation, failed lookbacks, pulse/readout work, confidence allocation, fitting, bit arithmetic, and later target execution. Its schedule language is complete sweeps or suitable full-system blocks; individual-site schedules may leave unobserved invariant coordinates, making the strict all-word certificate uninformative. This is an algorithmic simulator construction, not a physical interface or an efficiency result.

# Promoting acquired linear knowledge to stochastic path prediction

Private construction, 2026-10-24. Historical novelty is UNKNOWN. This draft
uses established strong Markov lumpability and polynomial factorization; the
candidate contribution is the finite least-refinement construction for arbitrary
rational linear observables, with source-level rather than population-state
enumeration. Species-partition and rule-based reductions are mandatory priors.

## 1. Obtainable contract and the change of scientific question

Input is a finite list of integer jumps nu_j in Z^n and polynomial propensities
a_j in Q[x], given by explicit sparse coefficients. They define a nonexplosive
continuous-time Markov chain on N^n: a_j(x)>=0 there, and a_j(x)=0 whenever
x+nu_j is outside N^n. The generator is

    A phi(x) = sum_j a_j(x) [phi(x+nu_j)-phi(x)].

Independent symbolic parameters may be included by requiring each coefficient
identity for all allowed parameter values in an open set. Repeated-reactant
propensities must be the actual stochastic falling-factorial polynomials, not
silently substituted deterministic powers. A specified stopped process is another
valid contract, but its boundary propensities must be represented and checked.

This is not an algorithm for recognizing every nonnegative polynomial rate or
every nonexplosive source. In the executable scientific cases, source syntax
gives positive mass-action rates and boundary validity, and separate conservation
or proper linear Lyapunov certificates warrant nonexplosion. Those certificates
were constructed and exactly checked in source_warrants.py; they are paid
preprocessing. An arbitrary source without such a warrant remains outside the
claimed acquired interface. A stopped source need not satisfy the universal-grid
necessity argument below, so its leastness requires a separate domain argument.

matrix L0. It may have been acquired from earlier deterministic tasks, or may just

instantaneous drift. The desired output is the least rational linear extension
of W0 that is a strong Markov lumping, and an executable reduced jump generator.
